description: Pub. 596 Worksheet 1 lines 5–7: § 1231 gain from Form 4797 isn't investment income. The same $15,000 installment gain on business land (§ 1231, Form 4797 line 4) leaves investment income at $0 — the EITC is allowed (AGI $35,000). EIC Table, one child, AGI $35,000 (row $35,000–$35,050, midpoint $35,025): $4,328 − 15.98% × ($35,025 − $23,350) = $2,462.
